_note: The full 11-deck league (checkpoints/league/) -- the primary training target. Roster is the complete data/league_decks.json manifest. Run mechanics are inherited from baseline_settings.json via "extends" rather than retyped here, except three deliberate overrides (see tests/test_run_league.py's _MAIN_LEAGUE_DELIBERATE_OVERRIDES, which pins exactly this set so it can't silently grow into a full duplicate copy again): n_workers 6->10 and games_per_iteration 24->60 (2026-08-24, wall-clock throughput -- 60/10=6 games/worker, divides evenly with no straggler workers, within this machine's 12 logical cores once the orchestrator process's own core is accounted for), and checkpoint_opponent_rate 0.15->0.30 alongside stratify_0land_pct=0.33 (matches tiny-league's own forced-0-land-hand mulligan exposure setup -- stratify only fires against a frozen-snapshot opponent, so checkpoint_opponent_rate had to rise for it to have anywhere to fire). create_training_league=true: an independently-trained twin (same roster/mechanics, including these overrides) is auto-managed under checkpoints/main-league-training/, fixed at 10,000 games/deck -- see run_training_pipeline.py's own docstring.
_status: Checkpoints deleted in the 2026-08-17 cleanup, so this league starts from zero. No preparation step is needed any more: per-deck encoders removed the pretrain/freeze phase, and a deck with no live.pt starts from a freshly-initialized net (vocab.json is rewritten on demand). Run run_training_pipeline.py --config against this file to train from scratch (run_league.py is now the lower-level, session-at-a-time tool; run_training_pipeline.py owns the whole run plus the validation cadence).
_open_meta_problem: mono_red_rally wins 85.5% of its non-mirror games against this roster (4,931/5,770 measured at 6,984 games/deck), from 74% vs mono_blue_terror up to 100% vs spy_combo, while its own mirror sits at a clean 49.6%. The other ten decks therefore spend much of training in matchups whose outcome is near-determined, where the terminal reward carries almost no gradient. Ten optimizer/architecture hypotheses for the resulting plateau were tested and all came back null. Owner's assessment (2026-08-17): mono_red_rally is implemented correctly and the gap is strategic facets the other decks' agents cannot currently express or perceive -- which is what WORK_CHECKLIST.md items 2-4 are aimed at, not another hyperparameter.
